ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution favoring low-intensity (black) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to a small basal region and terminal tips. Estimated ratio of 0.08:0.92.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous field across both lobes. A high-contrast irregular white blob is situated at the inferior medial boundary of the left lobe near the peduncle. Scattered high-intensity pixel stippling is present across the central dark fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular amplitude serrations (peaks/valleys) along the superior boundary of both lobes. Significant pixel-depth variation in serration patterns, particularly on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, with a localized concave inflection point immediately adjacent to the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) are present at the terminal tips of both lobes; highest density cluster is located at the apex of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, low-width linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged erosion/irregularity on the left terminal tip compared to the right, suggesting physical trauma or localized wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense mask of high-intensity water spray/droplets obscuring the inferior boundary of the fluke and introducing high-frequency noise across the surface texture.
